capabilities: render a live home dashboard block with tasks, habits, stats and an activity map
lay out embedded images and drawings with alignment, resizing, floating text, frames and captions
colour folders and headings and browse a gallery of quotes, callouts, panels and dividers
run a pomodoro or stopwatch focus timer and log habits from the dashboard
sync tasks, focus records and habits with TickTick, including a task centre and note sync
disambiguation: Not a theme itself; despite the Damask name it works with any theme, and Damask only adds palette picking and ornaments.
extras: Renamed from Damascene Studio and also absorbs Vault Studio, migrating settings on first run; beta builds are offered via BRAT; localised in English, Arabic (with right-to-left support), French, Spanish and Turkish. The TickTick sync has deletion safeguards, stopping before removing more than five tasks at once.
intentEvidence: it reads the old plugin's settings, habits, layouts and focus history on first run
problem: Obsidian has no built-in home page or single control panel for folder colours, embed layout styling, focus sessions and habit logging.

relations.evidence: The companion plugin for the Damask theme
Install Damask Studio from the plugin browser and enable it: it reads the old plugin's settings
Enable Damask Studio and it copies your settings, habits, layouts and TickTick connection
Connect with a personal API token from TickTick's settings
Point at an image or Excalidraw drawing: align it, drag its edges to resize
it follows your Daily notes or Periodic Notes settings by default

summary: Companion to the Damask theme that adds a home dashboard, embed layout tools, folder colours, a focus timer, habits and optional TickTick sync.
